notes: v499 — a new 💤 caution on any share that traded well under its own normal volume today, with the exact percentage on it. It comes from the full replay of the stored year: the quietest tenth of shares did worse than the market by 0.21% over the next five days and 0.53% over twenty, and it got steadily better from there — so the useful part is avoiding the dead end, not chasing the busy end. It is deliberately a WARNING and not a filter: once you allow for the fact that you cannot buy until the next day, the effect sits inside its own margin of error, and nothing is being removed from your lists because of it. It is also a plain practical point — whatever is hard to buy today is hard to sell later. Two tooltips left over from v498 have been corrected as well. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
